title: Pipeline
statement: Implement `solve(words)`. Normalize by stripping and lowercasing, then drop blanks. Return the remaining words in order. Do the work as two stages: a normalize stage and a drop-blank stage. The result is what the caller sees after composing them.
constraints: words is a list of strings
hints: First stage: strip and lower each word, including ones that become empty.
Do not drop before lowercasing. The case fold happens on the stripped text.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Two generators compose by iteration: the second pulls from the first.

editorial: Two generators compose by iteration: the second pulls from the first. Mixing both decisions into one loop is shorter and harder to reuse. The tests check the composition, including a word that is only spaces and a word whose case changes.
